changelog.title: A teleprompter for your reels
changelog.desc: Filming? Tap ▶ Teleprompter under any script. It opens full screen in big text. Tap Play and the words scroll for you, with the line to say lit up. Use − and + to change the speed, and A− and A+ to change the text size. Tap the script to pause. It does not use AI credits.

changelog.title: Where to find the teleprompter
changelog.desc: In a content card: under Generate Content, Hooks, Caption Variations, Shrink, Your version, and Your draft. Also under every Director Chat reply, above your draft in the Writing Studio, and inside any saved draft. Have a script from somewhere else? In Director Chat, tap Open the teleprompter (paste any script).

changelog.title: Rebuild in My Voice is now one button
changelog.desc: Paste the link to a post you like, pick your platform and format, and tap Rebuild this post in my voice. It gets the post and writes your version in one go, right next to the button. With a link it uses 2 AI credits. If you paste the words in yourself it uses 1.

changelog.title: The slides stay on your card
changelog.desc: When you rebuild a post from a link, the pictures of its slides now stay on the card, so you can look back at them any time on the device you used.

changelog.title: Repurposed File keeps your version
changelog.desc: Tap + Repurposed File above your version to keep it. It saves your version, the original post, and why it worked if you asked for that.

changelog.title: Guides are up to date
changelog.desc: The Studio Guide and the How to use each section list now cover everything above.
